method: Viewed actual source artwork, producer mask/contact sheets, independently extracted native-resolution motion and last-two/first-two seam crops, and source/video region comparisons. Fully decoded all 84 frames per video and independently recomputed adjacent-frame, seam, inside/outside-mask and brightness metrics. Verified SHA-256 before/after decode and at report writing.
limitations: No full-speed playback or audio audition performed.
Approval applies only to exact visual hashes, not integrated product quality or production readiness.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Viewed actual source artwork, producer mask/contact sheet, eight native-resolution samples each of coffee steam and balcony foliage, source-to-video comparisons and last-two/first-two seam crops. Mug rim, handle, floral pattern, chair, books, curtain and skyline stay in place.

Transparent coffee steam changes gently above the mug, without an opaque patch or a duplicate mug rim. Balcony foliage shifts only slightly; sampled flowers/leaves retain coherent shapes, without obvious crossblend ghosts. Source-to-video comparisons retain rigid background edges.

Independent decode of all 84 frames gives seam ratio 1.9981, outside-mask change 0.000094 and peak frame-brightness change 0.007805. Boundary samples show no obvious geometry discontinuity. Full-speed perceived smoothness remains unverified.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Viewed actual source artwork, producer mask/contact sheet, eight native-resolution samples of both blue window regions and foreground tea steam, source-to-video comparisons and last-two/first-two seam crops. Room framing, books, furniture, cup rim and distant architecture remain stable.

Water-light changes are extremely restrained. The prominent shark and schools of fish retain their source silhouettes and positions; no additional displaced fish or doubled rigid castle edges are visible in the examined source comparisons and motion crops. The foreground steam is subtle and transparent, without an opaque plume or duplicate cup.

Independent decode of all 84 frames gives seam ratio 2.0686, outside-mask change 0.000112 and peak frame-brightness change 0.008979. No obvious last/first geometry jump appears. The intentionally still fish can make the scene feel like a lightly animated illustration; full-speed experiential assessment remains outstanding.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.
